description: NaCo(CO)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcm space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.40 Å) and two longer (2.41 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Co is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four C atoms. There are two shorter (1.74 Å) and two longer (1.75 Å) Co-C bond lengths. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Co and one O atom. The C-O bond length is 1.18 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Co and one O atom. The C-O bond length is 1.17 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Co and one O atom. The C-O bond length is 1.18 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom.
